standard.summary: 逗号分隔模块名。空 + 下方 auto 开 → 后端按族选单层 mid
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Comma-separated module names. Empty, plus the auto below turned on -> the backend picks a single mid layer by family
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 逗号分隔模块名。空 + 下方 auto 开 → 后端按族选单层 mid（省 hook 税）。

advanced_en.principle: Comma-separated module names. Empty + auto on above → the backend picks a single mid layer per family (saves hook overhead).
